verdict.rationale: Resend's first-party docs say to build email templates in React with React Email and send them through the API. Hands-on community reports confirm that writing templates in React syntax works and is a key draw. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party React Email documentation in the pack (only a one-line llms.txt mention), explicit evidence of a version-control or templates-in-repo workflow, and any mention of MJML or other frameworks.
